CREATE TABLE "public"."class_promo_assets" (
  "ai_image_generation_id" uuid,
  "class_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "cover_source" text,
  "intro_draft_id" uuid,
  "intro_source" text,
  "intro_text" text,
  "reviewed_at" timestamptz,
  "reviewed_by_staff_account_id" uuid,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "uploaded_photo_file_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("class_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_promo_assets_cover_6970b23a" CHECK ((uploaded_photo_file_id IS NULL OR cover_source = 'uploaded_photo') AND (cover_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'ai_image' OR (ai_image_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND uploaded_photo_file_id IS NULL)) AND (cover_source IS NOT NULL OR (uploaded_photo_file_id IS NULL AND ai_image_generation_id IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_promo_assets_intro_ca7d2f03" CHECK ((intro_text IS NULL) = (intro_source IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_promo_assets_intro_len_04874cc3" CHECK (intro_text IS NULL OR char_length(intro_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 600),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_promo_assets_review_68120c21" CHECK ((reviewed_at IS NULL) = (reviewed_by_staff_account_id IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "class_promo_assets_cover_source_check_94ea384e" CHECK ("cover_source" IN ('uploaded_photo', 'ai_image')),
  CONSTRAINT "class_promo_assets_intro_source_check_cea4d1ef" CHECK ("intro_source" IN ('ai', 'ai_edited', 'user'))
)
